# Turn a selfie into a satirical woke profile set with GPT Image 2.6

**One selfie becomes 11 satirical woke tiles, a 4:5 collage for X and an MP4, made on GPT Image 2.6 (aka Wokify).**

<p><img src="https://s3.varg.ai/files/194b94d0-58ff-4e8b-91de-4f1959d04013/file_f611911628bb.webp" alt="Satirical GPT Image 2.6 profile shots of one man: a protest selfie with friends, a TV street interview, a holographic trading card and a cat in a rainbow scarf." width="480"></p>

Turn one selfie into a satirical "I MADE ME WOKE" profile set with GPT Image 2.6, the image model in ChatGPT (aka Wokify): 11 woke versions of you (character sheet, woke friends photo, LinkedIn-style profile, DEI video call, protest TV interview, action figure, holographic trading card, woke cat, oat latte, "In this house" home, WOKEOPOLY), four as looping GIFs, in a 4:5 collage sized for X plus an MP4, and an optional HyperFrames presenter-mode video. One command on varg, about $0.78; the prompts also work pasted into ChatGPT. Use when someone wants to make themselves woke, wokify a photo or profile picture, a woke AI filter, the "I made me woke" trend, a ChatGPT image prompt pack for a selfie, an AI action figure or trading card of themselves, or a collage of AI versions of one person. Not for photos of others without consent, public figures, or mocking LGBTQ+ people themselves (the joke is on performative habits and brands).

```bash
npx skills add vargHQ/skills --skill make-a-woke-profile-with-chatgpt                # Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok, Gemini CLI, OpenCode…
gh skill install vargHQ/skills make-a-woke-profile-with-chatgpt --agent github-copilot --scope user
# or all 83 skills as a Claude Code plugin:
claude plugin marketplace add vargHQ/skills
claude plugin install varg@varg
```

## Ask your agent

- "Wokify my selfie ./me.jpg, name Alex, pronouns he/they, and make the 4:5 collage for X"
- "Make the "I made me woke" set from my photo plus an animated MP4 of the collage"
- "Give me the ChatGPT prompts to turn my selfie into a woke action figure and a holographic trading card"
